title: Brokoli resolved execution record v1 (ADR-033 section 4)
description: Canonical machine-readable contract for the deterministic, control-plane-owned payload selection ADR-033 section 4 requires before a 'task' node attempt is dispatched. Pinning this record before ClaimAttempt is what makes a retry reuse the exact same bytes: worker matching, requirements, and the eventual instance work-order's 'task' object (section 6) all derive from it, never from a worker's own independent choice. Rollout phase 1 artifact (issue #439 step 5): no Go code produces, persists, or consults this record yet -- there is no physical-planning integration, no ClaimAttempt wiring, and retries do not yet reuse it. Field names mirror the instance work-order envelope's 'task' object in ADR-033 section 6 exactly, so a future implementation copies rather than re-derives them.

runtime_protocol.description: e.g. 'brokoli.task-runtime/v1'. One of the placement predicate's own AND-clauses (section 5).

payload_id.description: The selected payload's id within the bundle manifest's payloads[] (task-bundle-v2.json).

execution_environment_digest.description: Covers adapter/harness bytes, the exact runtime build, dependency artifacts, platform ABI, and declared system libraries (section 4 rule 3) -- a superset of payload_digest, not a duplicate of it.

interface_digest.description: Must equal the referencing 'task' node's own declared interface digest (ADR-032); a mismatch is resolved at admission, never silently at dispatch.

execution_profile.description: Trust-profile name and policy revision, e.g. 'standard@7' (section 6's own worked example). The revision pins policy identity the same way a digest pins bytes -- a later policy change is a new revision, not a silent behavior change under the same name.
